Department Profile
About Bengali
Chilarai College came into existence on January 26, 1973. From the very beginning the department of Bengali has been playing a pivotal role in shaping the future of a vast majority of young aspiration in this socio-economically backward Indo-Bangladesh border area. The Department is a quite experienced and matured department since inception of the college. It has a Departmental Library having sufficient text books and reference books to support teaching – learning process. There are provisions of remedial classes for slow learners and additional classes especially for honours students. It has a strong and compact faculty to quench the thirst of knowledge of the students.
VISION & MISION:
To promote a value based education through the literary experience of Bengali humanisitic literature.
To contribute to the transformation of society through the ideals set by great Bengali writers and thinkers like Ishwar Chandra Vidyasagar,Rabindranath Tagore, Kazi Nazrul Islam,Sukanta Bhattacharya,Buddhadeva Bose among others, by being being socially conscious and responsible.
To promote inter-cultural and inter-religious harmony through literature and literary activities.
Future Plan:
We plan to arrange a couple of awareness camp or seminars for the benefit of society and create interest in perusing Bengali.
We have a plan to develop our departmental library with our sincere effort in collaboration with college authority.
As a part of continuous evaluation we plan to arrange seminars, workshops, group discussions, project work, field study etc.
The department has been instrumental in motivating young students to develop future carrier in education by proceeding for further studies.
We have a plan to introduce more skill based course in the coming years..
We have a plan to involve the advance learner of the department in extensive research related activities.
